senses.gloss: m. (אָרַע I) event, occasion. Sifré Deut. s. 1; Yalk. ib. 792 נקראו על שם המ׳ they were named from a certain event which occurred there.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37">Gen. R. s. 37</cite>, end <he>היו מוציאין שמן לשם המ׳</he> they passed (invented) names referring to events (instead of to genealogy).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:11">Y. Taan. I, 63ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לפי הזמן … לפי המ׳</he> according to the season, according to the needs of the occasion.

<cite ref="Shabbat 24a:4">Sabb. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ואומר מעין המ׳</he> and insert words (in the prayer) corresponding to the needs of the occasion; (<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:10">Tosef. Ber. III, 10</cite>, sq. <cite ref="M00671"><he>מוּרָע</he></cite> ed. Zuck., Var. <cite ref="M00016"><he>מאורע</he></cite>); a. fr.
